intro: We help retailers, healthcare providers and growing brands in Calicut and the wider Malabar region reach more customers online, in Kerala and in the Gulf.
whatsappMessage: Hi Helix24, I am looking for digital marketing services in Calicut.
market: Calicut is a trading city, and many of its businesses, from textile and jewellery shops to food brands, now sell well beyond the city through Instagram and online stores. Good product content and a store that works smoothly on a phone matter as much as the ads themselves.

Malabar also has some of the strongest family links to the GCC in Kerala, so a single campaign can reach customers in Kozhikode, Malappuram and Dubai at the same time, if it is set up for each audience.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in Calicut if your office is in Kochi?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with Calicut clients on WhatsApp, phone and video calls, and plan campaigns, content and reports the same way as for any other city.

faqs.q: Can you help a Calicut brand sell to customers in the Gulf?
faqs.a: Yes. We can run separate Meta Ads for GCC audiences and set up an online store with international payments and shipping.

faqs.q: What works better in Calicut: Google Ads or Instagram ads?
faqs.a: It depends on the product. People searching for a clinic or a service respond well to Google Ads, while fashion, food and lifestyle brands usually do better on Instagram. Our Google Ads vs Meta Ads guide explains the difference.
